. Its stats and its abilities' numbers grow in a straight line from level 1 to level 100, and a rarer pet has more of them. Its tooltip shows them at its level, and the progress to the next level.
A rarer pet needs more XP for each level: a Legendary pet starts further up Hypixel's pet XP table than a Common one.

A pet's abilities work while it's out, with their numbers at its level and rarity (a Tier Boost counts). About half of Hypixel's pet abilities work so far (348 of the 685 ability tiers, on 67 of the 88 pets):
